method:
Independent ROM and HUD regression audit for the final Drain/UI studies.

The native painters provide expected indexed pixels. This tool never imports
build_assets, its deduplicator, parse_art or 4bpp packer. ROM pixels are decoded
independently, including hardware flips and RGB555 banks. The original room's
resolved type/collision/prop/glitter values stay exact despite new picture IDs.
Runtime checks use real mGBA OAM/VRAM and normal menu inputs; disclosed resource,
equipment and isolated contact fixtures do not substitute mockup framebuffers.

allowed_changes.drain: Final657 independent picture IDs, native geometry/palette/animations; original per-cell collision/type/prop/glitter and objects unchanged.
allowed_changes.interface: Five UI material/frame/mark/HUD studies; compact12px top HUD, conditional equipped ammunition and native16px bottom-right minimap; interface palettes/font presentation may change.
allowed_changes.actors: Selected first frog and pointed wizard; keeper face banks; HUD miniatures/markers; rail source art.
allowed_changes.protected: Bloom/Step-and-cut, all other actor/item/enemy pixel payloads, title bitmap, forest/interior art/animation, original gameplay metadata, item tables and interaction timing arrays.

runtime.fixture_note: Inventory/resources are explicit HUD state fixtures; action timing uses an isolated ordinary enemy on a local floor fixture. All observed art is real ROM OAM/VRAM.
